items.title: 8.8.1 Kuch aham reactions ke equilibrium constant expressions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8.1, printed pages 174-176.

blocks.text: Ethanol ethanoic acid se react kar ke ethyl ethanoate aur pani banata hai, CH3COOH(l) + C2H5OH(l) se CH3COOC2H5(l) + H2O(l). Equilibrium par mixture ke 500 cm3 mein 0.235 mol ethanoic acid, 0.0350 mol ethanol, 0.182 mol ethyl ethanoate aur 0.182 mol pani the. Qadam 1, 0.5 dm3 mein concentrations: 0.470, 0.070, 0.364 aur 0.364 mol dm-3. Qadam 2, Kc = [CH3COOC2H5][H2O] / ([CH3COOH][C2H5OH]). Qadam 3, qeematein rakhein: Kc = (0.364 x 0.364) / (0.470 x 0.070) = 4.03 teen significant figures tak. Qadam 4, units: mol dm-3 cancel ho jate hain, to Kc = 4.03 bina units.
Sample Problem 8.2: propanone aur hydrogen cyanide

Propanone hydrogen cyanide se react karta hai, CH3COCH3(l) + HCN(g) se CH3C(OH)(CN)CH3(l). 0.0500 mol dm-3 propanone aur 0.0500 mol dm-3 hydrogen cyanide ka mixture kamre ke darja hararat par 0.0233 mol dm-3 product concentration ke saath equilibrium pata hai. Bane har mole product ke liye har reactant ka ek mole kharch hota hai, to equilibrium par har reactant 0.0500 - 0.0233 = 0.0267 mol dm-3 hai. Kc = [product] / ([CH3COCH3][HCN]) = 0.0233 / (0.0267 x 0.0267) = 32.7, units (mol dm-3)^-1, yani mol-1 dm3.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sample 8.2 mein kitab ne Kc ke expression mein reactants ki jagah 0.05 mol dm-3 rakha hai; equilibrium par dono reactants 0.0500 - 0.0233 = 0.0267 mol dm-3 hain, aur 0.0233 / (0.0267 x 0.0267) = 32.7 isi se banta hai. Kitab ne unit 'mol dm-3' likha hai; sahi unit (mol dm-3)^-1 yani mol-1 dm3 hai, kyunke neeche do concentrations aur oopar ek hai. Sample 8.1 mein bhi expression mein pani ki concentration '0.0364' chhapi hai; sahi 0.364 mol dm-3 hai (jawab 4.03 isi se aata hai).

blocks.prompt: H2(g) + CO2(g) se H2O(g) + CO(g) ke liye H2 aur CO2 ki ibtidai concentrations 10.00 mol dm-3 har ek aur CO ki equilibrium concentration 9.47 mol dm-3 hai. Kc nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Bana har mole CO H2 aur CO2 ka ek ek mole kharch karta aur H2O ka ek mole banata hai. Equilibrium par [CO] = [H2O] = 9.47 aur [H2] = [CO2] = 10.00 - 9.47 = 0.53 mol dm-3. Kc = (9.47 x 9.47) / (0.53 x 0.53) = 89.7 / 0.281 = 319, bina units kyunke moles barabar hain.

items: Ammonia ke liye Kc: [NH3]^2 / [N2][H2]^3; N2O5 ke tootne ke liye: [NO2]^4 [O2] / [N2O5]^2.
Sample 8.1: ester banna, 0.5 dm3 par moles se concentrations, Kc = 4.03 bina units. Sample 8.2: har reactant se bana product manfi karein, Kc = 0.0233 / 0.0267^2 = 32.7.
